statements.status_notes: See CVE-2026-45447 entry on libssl3. Mirrored here because Trivy reports the Ubuntu Noble package under the libssl3t64 name.
statements.impact_statement: Scanner over-match: libssl3t64 is Ubuntu Noble's time64 ABI transition rename of libssl3 (see sibling assessment above). The same not_affected rationale applies — Liquibase Secure does not process PKCS#7 or S/MIME signed messages through OpenSSL PKCS#7 APIs, and no PKCS7_verify, PKCS7_, S/MIME, or related call sites exist in repository sources.
